name: Saveria Sacco
bioAdditions: Saveria was baptized on 31 March 1776, daughter of Bruno Sacco and Marianna Cicco (S1). She married Alessio Moraca in 1792. She died on 31 October 1841 as his widow (S2, S3).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, death and burial consistent; daughter Carmela's records name her.
